## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic completed 390 photographic captures during April 2025. This activity represents the site’s recorded screening output for the month. The service continued to process captures for image assessment and grading within its normal operational arrangements. No new equipment faults were raised by staff during the reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 20 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.1 per cent. These images could not be used for grading and are included in the reported monthly image-quality results. The site should continue to monitor image acquisition and provide feedback where image quality issues are identified.

## Grading

A total of 109 results were graded as referable. The median grading wait was 1 day. This indicates that the midpoint of the grading turnaround for the month was within the reported period. Activity, image quality and grading results should continue to be reviewed through routine site monitoring to support timely follow-up and maintain consistent service performance.
